Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: In step 4, the WebSurfer searched for "Kim Dae-hwan birth date" and incorrectly retrieved the birth date of a South Korean football player (born Jan 1, 1976) instead of the director of the film "End of Winter." The search results clearly showed a profile for a footballer ("Suwon Samsung Bluewings") rather than the film director. The agent failed to disambiguate the name "Kim Dae-hwan" and did not verify that the retrieved information corresponded to the correct individual (the director of the 2014 film), leading to an incorrect data point that prevents the final comparison.
